# outputs/ — everything regenerated by the pipeline

Nothing here is edited by hand. Most content is gitignored; the tracked parts are listed with
`git ls-files outputs`. Regenerate with the commands in `AGENTS.md`.

| Subfolder / file | Contents | Generated by | Tracked? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `A2_Output_Params/` | Per-scenario parameter CSVs compiled from the A-O workbooks | B1 (`B1_Run_Compiler.py`, DVC stage `preprocess`) | Yes (`cache: false`) |
| `A2_Outputs_Params_otoole/` | otoole-formatted parameter CSVs | B2 (`B2_Executing_OG_Model.py`, DVC stage `executing`) | Yes |
| `A2_Structure_Lists.xlsx` | Sets/structure lists produced by B1 | B1 | No |
| `Executables/` | Per-scenario `Pre_processed_*.txt` datafiles, patched chain, solver runs | B2 | Only the `*_RMCarefulXLSX.txt` and `*_FLOORED.txt` per scenario (currently 0 committed; the on-disk `Executables/<scenario>_0/` folders are untracked scratch) |
| `model/` | `osemosys_fast_preprocessed_storage_delay.txt`, the storage-delay-patched OSeMOSYS model file | B2 | Yes (1 file; not declared as a DVC `outs`) |
| `logs/` | Run logs | B1/B2 | No (`*log*` is gitignored) |
| `Figures/` | `Report/`, `Presentation/`, `Dashboard/dashboard.html`, `Tablas_Completas_Resultados.xlsx`, caches | `scripts/figures/run_all.py` | Partially — 3 legacy files tracked (`_dashboard_data.csv`, `cf_corregido_brasil.html`, `dashboard_20260716.html`); `Dashboard/`, `Report/`, `Presentation/`, `Tablas_Completas_Resultados*.xlsx` and the scenario/reduction caches are gitignored |
| `RELAC_TX_Inputs*.csv`, `RELAC_TX_Outputs*.csv`, `RELAC_TX_Combined_Inputs_Outputs*.csv` | Concatenated inputs/outputs of all scenarios (`_YYYY-MM-DD` dated copies) | B2 → `scripts/tools/concatenate_relac.py` | No |
| `RELAC_TX_StorageDelay_*.csv`, `RELAC_TX_data*.txt` | StorageDelay variants and raw datafile dumps (~390 MB each) | B2 | No |
| `fix_dispatch/`, `tx_chain/`, `experimental/`, `templates/`, `legacy/` | Working outputs of the respective `scripts/` folders | their scripts | `fix_dispatch/`: Yes (9 files, e.g. `candidate_floors_summary.csv`, `fig_floor_effect.png`, from `scripts/fix_dispatch/`). `tx_chain/`: No — untracked scratch from `scripts/tx_chain/cost_sensitivity_v_*.py` legacy mode. `experimental/`: Yes (2 files under `veg_tx_abs_test/`, a one-off snapshot from `scripts/tx_chain/veg_tx_constraints.py`). `templates/`: No — untracked, written by `scripts/tools/Z_generate_country_template.py`; empty on disk today. `legacy/`: Yes (1 file, `Blend_Shares_0.pickle`, already committed before the `*backup*`/`*log*` ignore rules existed; new matching files would now be gitignored). |
